purpose: Manual GPT-6 Sol activation evaluation. Present prompts without expected routes; compare selected routes afterward. Integrity tests do not measure model activation.

should_trigger: Нужно с нуля провести персонажа через Blender: референс, модель, rig, анимации и проверку экспорта.
I have a Blender asset task but need the correct modeling versus rigging workflow and acceptance gates.
should_not_trigger: Change only the right elbow weight paint on the named armature.
Review the front silhouette against this supplied image.

edge.prompt: Make the character match the reference, then rig and export it.
edge.reason: Multi-stage request needs a router plus the relevant specialists.

should_trigger: Сделай форму палочника максимально похожей на приложенный референс с фронта и сбоку.
Compare this model's silhouette and landmarks against the orthographic sheet.
should_not_trigger: Design a new character freely without any supplied image.
Rename one existing animation Action.

edge.prompt: The model looks wrong from the side, but the front must stay unchanged.
edge.reason: Locked front projection and side mismatch require diagnosis before editing.

should_trigger: Create an editable character blockout from the agreed proportions.
Change this character's head-to-body proportions while preserving the approved costume.
Improve the front and side silhouette of the body mesh.
Remodel the head and torso primary forms to match the approved shape.
Add modeled clothing and accessory geometry without changing the rig.
should_not_trigger: Add new animation Actions to the existing rig.
Repair only the shoulder weight painting.
Rebuild or edit the armature hierarchy.
Perform final retopology on an approved sculpt without changing its form.
Export the unchanged character as GLB and validate it in Godot.

edge.prompt: The elbow's neutral geometry is visibly too thin; correct its shape while preserving the existing rig and weights.
edge.reason: The neutral form is a modeling issue, but deformation and protected data still need verification.

diagnostic_edges.prompt: The elbow deforms badly when bent; determine whether weights, pivots, topology or form caused it.
diagnostic_edges.reason: Observed deformation alone does not assign modeling ownership.

diagnostic_edges.prompt: The arm looks wrong only during the attack animation.
diagnostic_edges.reason: Inspect the Action, rig, weights and geometry before editing form.

diagnostic_edges.prompt: The model looks wrong only after GLB export.
diagnostic_edges.reason: Isolate exporter/importer effects before remodeling the source.

should_trigger: Round out only the left cheek while keeping the eye and jaw landmarks.
Use a bounded sculpt pass to correct this calf volume.
should_not_trigger: Rebuild elbow edge loops for a clean bend.
Inspect whether the GLB contains every Action.

edge.prompt: Smooth this shoulder, but it is already skinned and the weights must survive.
edge.reason: Regional form edit with explicit topology and weight protection.

should_trigger: Fix topology at the shoulder so it bends without collapse.
Retopologize the approved sculpt for the required knee motion.
should_not_trigger: Increase the head's overall volume without changing topology.
Add an idle Action to this existing rig.

edge.prompt: The elbow pinches when bent; first determine whether weights or loops are responsible.
edge.reason: Diagnosis precedes a topology edit; weights may be the actual owner.

should_trigger: Проверь персонажа с нескольких ракурсов и в крайних позах, ничего не меняя.
Review the exported GLB for scale, skeleton, clips and material appearance.
should_not_trigger: Create a mesh from this concept sketch.
Sculpt a stronger jawline.

edge.prompt: The import succeeded; can we mark visual and deformation acceptance complete?
edge.reason: Import is lower-level evidence; visual and pose checks remain necessary.

should_trigger: Create a stylized quadruped cat with believable shoulder, hock and paw structure.
Blend human torso and arm behavior with digitigrade animal legs for this anthropomorphic character.
should_not_trigger: Model a modular building facade with reusable windows and roof sections.
Fix only the existing humanoid character's shoulder weights.

edge.prompt: The anthropomorphic fox should stand upright but keep clearly digitigrade leg mechanics.
edge.reason: Regional human/animal blending and animal limb mechanics belong to the animal specialist.

should_trigger: Two shoulder fixes failed; diagnose the cause and make one measured correction.
Use the saved before and after views to improve the head proportion without changing approved eyes.
should_not_trigger: Make a new blockout from the drawing.
Export the unchanged model as GLB.

edge.prompt: The front got better but the side became worse after this revision.
edge.reason: The iteration needs anti-degradation review and a keep/correct/revert decision.

should_trigger: Add a jump Action to the existing armature and preserve all current clips.
Fix shoulder weights and verify the pose in Blender and Godot.
should_not_trigger: Only compare silhouette against the reference.
Paint the base-color texture without rig changes.

edge.prompt: Export cloth movement to Godot; decide how motion should survive GLB.
edge.reason: Secondary-motion transfer and import are rig/export concerns.
